title: Navigation: persistent shell with full keyboard operability and landmark roles
description: The application shell provides top-level navigation (with optional side navigation for secondary structure), visible and programmatically exposed active states, a skip-link as the first focusable element, ARIA landmark roles on the shell regions, and complete keyboard operation: Tab and Shift-Tab traverse, arrow keys move within menus, Escape closes any open overlay.
rationale: Navigation is the one surface every journey crosses. If it is not keyboard-complete and landmark-labelled, no journey in the application can meet the accessibility bar.
